He pressed the paper flat against the glass of the lantern room, read it twice, then set it on the sill where the morning light would find it.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一张尚未醒来的脸。街灯在薄雾里发出黄色的光，空旷的马路上偶尔驶过一辆出租车，轮胎碾过潮湿的沥青。早点铺的窗口透出暖光，蒸笼腾起白气，老人默默揉着面团。写字楼还黑着，只有保洁的身影在走廊里移动。远处传来第一班公交的引擎声，鸟还没有叫，天边泛起一线灰蓝。城市在这一刻属于那些不睡的人，安静，疲惫，却又藏着新一天将要开始的微小预兆。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a big problem by doing a tiny bit, then asking a smaller copy of itself to do the rest.\n• It keeps shrinking the problem until it's so small the answer is obvious, like counting down to zero.\n• Think of standing in a line of mirrors: each reflection shows the next, smaller one, until they're too tiny to see."}
